answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The atlas holds work receipts rather than names, so the ocean of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the kernel of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
